long_biography.plain_text:
Shahid "Shad" Khan remains the owner and chief executive of Flex-N-Gate, the automotive supplier he assembled through product design and acquisition. His one-piece truck bumper removed welds that were vulnerable to corrosion and gave the new Bumper Works business a distinctive manufacturing product.

Khan had joined Flex-N-Gate while studying industrial engineering at the University of Illinois and rose from a student job to chief engineer. He left in 1978 to establish Bumper Works, then bought his former employer two years later and folded the younger company into it. The two businesses formed the manufacturing base he still operates, while the Jacksonville Jaguars and Fulham Football Club became his durable sports holdings.
